scanNote:
12-BET. Unit 2 'A Friend in Need ...' boshlanishi.

Skaner bilan solishtirildi. Barcha javoblar TO'G'RI:
- 1-mashq: Alice (jingalak), Mario (to'lqinsimon), Helen (kalta kulrang), Anna (uzun tekis oq-sariq), Pierre (qora), John (mo'ylov), Jack (soqol va mo'ylov).
- 2-mashq: Helen, Pierre, Anna, Jack, Mario, John.
- 4-mashqdagi uch e'lonning hamma ma'lumoti (yosh, shahar, soch, ko'z, gavda, qiziqish, qobiliyat, oxirgi jumla) matn bilan aynan mos.

⚠ AUDIO KERAK EMAS: 3-mashqda 'listen and match' deyilgan, lekin to'rttala javob ham shu betdagi bosilgan e'lonlardan chiqadi (kompyuter o'yinlari = Pierre, gitara = Mario, chang'i = Anna, 'Hope to hear from you soon' = Marioning oxirgi jumlasi).

⚠⚠ KITOB XATOSI (terish): 2-e'londa (Anna) 'Please be my E--MAIL pen pal' deb bosilgan — 'e' bilan 'mail' orasida IKKITA tire bor. To'g'risi bitta tire: 'e-mail'. Kesib kattalashtirib tekshirdim.

  ⚠ Xuddi shu jumlada 'I'm  quite short' — 'I'm' bilan 'quite' orasida IKKITA bo'sh joy qolgan.

  ⚠ Solishtirish uchun: 1-e'londa (Pierre) xuddi shu so'z TO'G'RI — 'e-mail me today', bitta tire bilan. Ya'ni xato faqat 2-e'londa.

⚠ BRITANChA/AMERIKAChA NOMUVOFIQLIK: mashq sarlavhasida 'PEN-FRIENDS' (Britaniya varianti), Annaning e'lonida esa 'PEN PAL' (Amerika varianti) ishlatilgan. Ikkalasi ham 'xat orqali do'st' degani, lekin bir betda ikki variant aralashgan. Kitob Britaniya kursi bo'lgani uchun izchillik 'pen-friend' bo'lishi kerak edi.

⚠ FOYDALI TASDIQ: bu yerda ism 'PIERRE' — urg'usiz, TO'G'RI yozilgan. 72-73-betlarda esa xuddi shu ism 'Pièrre' deb noto'g'ri bosilgan. Demak kitobning o'zi izchil emas.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures. Who's got brown, curly hair? brown, wavy hair? short grey hair? long straight fair hair? dark hair? a moustache? a beard and a moustache?
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang. Kimda jigarrang jingalak soch bor? Jigarrang to'lqinsimon? Kalta kulrang? Uzun tekis oq-sariq? Qora soch? Mo'ylov? Soqol va mo'ylov?
exercises.explanationUz:
SOCH TA'RIFI qat'iy tartibda beriladi:
  UZUNLIK + SHAKL + RANG + hair
  'long straight fair hair' — uzun, tekis, oq-sariq soch

DIQQAT: 'Who's got' = 'Who has got' — qisqartma.
Soch haqida 'have got' ishlatiladi: 'She HAS GOT long hair'.

Yuz tuklari 'a' bilan keladi: a moustache (mo'ylov), a beard (soqol).

answers.descEn: Who's got long straight fair hair?
answers.descUz: Kimda uzun tekis oq-sariq soch bor?

answers.descEn: Who's got a beard and a moustache?

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the names of the people in the pictures.
exercises.explanationUz:
Tashqi ko'rinish sifatlari:
• old — keksa · young — yosh · middle-aged — o'rta yoshli
• tall — baland bo'yli · short — past bo'yli
• slim — nozik · well-built — baquvvat · fat — semiz

DIQQAT: 'fat' qo'pol eshitiladi. Odob bilan aytish uchun
'a bit overweight' yoki 'large' ishlatiladi.

'quite' — ancha, birmuncha: 'quite tall' = ancha baland.

items.uz: Anna past bo'yli va ancha nozik.

items.sentence: ___ is middle-aged and Pierre is young.
items.uz: Jack o'rta yoshli, Pierre esa yosh.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences, then listen and match the sentences to the speakers.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni o'qing, so'ng eshitib gaplarni gapiruvchilarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har gap e'londagi ma'lumotdan kelib chiqadi:
• kompyuter o'yinlari — Pierre (e'lon 1)
• gitara — Mario (e'lon 3)
• chang'i — Anna (e'lon 2)
• 'Hope to hear from you soon' — Marioning e'loni shu bilan tugaydi

answers.why: Marioning e'loni shu jumla bilan tugaydi

exercises.instructionEn: Read the Internet advertisements for pen-friends and answer the questions. Then, explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Pen-friend (xat orqali do'st) uchun internet e'lonlarini o'qing va savollarga javob bering. So'ng qalin yozilgan so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
E'lon qolipi — har uchalasi bir xil tartibda:
1) Ism va yosh: My name's X and I'm ... years old.
2) Joy: I live in SHAHAR, MAMLAKAT.
3) Tashqi ko'rinish: I have got + SOCH + eyes. I'm + bo'y/gavda.
4) Qiziqish: I like / I love + -ing.
5) Qobiliyat: I can + FE'L.
6) Chaqiriq: Please e-mail me / Hope to hear from you soon.

Shu qolip bo'yicha o'zingiz ham e'lon yoza olasiz.
exercises.readingNote: E'lonlarni kitobingizdan o'qing (12-bet). Quyida ularning ma'lumoti va barcha javoblar berilgan.

wordFormation.introUz: Tashqi ko'rinish va qiziqish bildiruvchi so'zlar.

groups.explanationUz: Ikki so'z birikib bitta sifat yasaydi. Chiziqcha SHART.
'like' va 'love' dan keyin fe'l -ing bilan keladi. Bu shakl mashg'ulot nomi ham bo'ladi.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Unit 2 ning o'zagi — tashqi ko'rinish va qobiliyat.

patterns.formula: EGA + have/has got + SOCH TA'RIFI + hair
patterns.exampleEn: I have got short straight dark hair.
patterns.exampleUz: Mening kalta, tekis, qora sochim bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
Tartib QAT'IY: uzunlik → shakl → rang → hair.
'long straight fair hair' to'g'ri; 'fair long straight hair' XATO.
I/you/we/they → have got · he/she/it → HAS got.
'eyes' doim KO'PLIK (ikkita ko'z). 'I have got a brown eye' — noto'g'ri.

patterns.exampleEn: I'm quite tall and slim. / Mario is tall and well-built.
patterns.exampleUz: Men ancha baland va nozikman. / Mario baland va baquvvat.
patterns.explanationUz: Bo'y va gavda uchun 'be' ishlatiladi, 'have got' emas.

patterns.exampleEn: I can play tennis very well. / She can play the piano.
patterns.exampleUz: Men tennisni juda yaxshi o'ynay olaman.
patterns.explanationUz: 'can' dan keyin fe'l O'ZGARMAYDI: 'he can play' (plays emas), 'to' ham qo'yilmaydi.

patterns.exampleEn: I love playing computer games. / I like reading.
patterns.exampleUz: Men kompyuter o'yinlarini o'ynashni yaxshi ko'raman.
patterns.explanationUz: 'like/love' dan keyin fe'l -ING oladi. 'I like read' — XATO.
